Rate limit middleware

Fixed-window in-memory limiter. The store lives in the middleware instance, so under runThreaded/runCluster (one app factory per worker) the effective limit is multiplied by the worker count; run a single worker or use an external store for a global limit.

Keying on forwarded headers honours the app-level proxy trust settings. Hop-count-only trust without a trustedProxyAllowlist lets a directly connected client rotate X-Forwarded-For to mint fresh buckets; configure an allowlist when rate limiting behind proxies.

Number of keys tracked by the most recently created rate limit store.Count of new keys dropped because the store reached its tracked-key capacity.Count of expired keys evicted to make room for new keys.Test-only: clear all state in the most recently created rate limit store.Fixed-window rate limit middleware keyed by trusted client IP.Rate limit middleware built from a named preset profile.
